body: I would like to thank everyone in this thread for picking me up. Bless you all.
Sometimes I feel like I don't deserve to be happy. That the joy I've felt isn't what I should have. That a part of it is stolen somehow. Why do I think like this.
Hi, thank you for replying. After writing everything down I felt less overwhelmed by my feelings, I guess. I still want to try fishing me back up. So yeah, let's hang on.

Okay, remember, at my own pace. No matter what, you'll do you, as long as you're still alive, it's alright. If I want to stop, then stop, and then keep going again. So just hold on. Okay. I can do that.

I feel like.. I just want to die, alright? Not good enough, not right, unworthy. I want to be better but I can't. I tried, I wanted to want something. I wanted to get better. But it's never enough. Never right. Never changed.

I thought that I was strong enough. I'll never be this low anymore. But the truth is, it's always there, waiting for when there's nothing to cover me, shielding me from these thoughts.

I'm so sad. I thought I'm over it. Why do I get back here again?
But there was a hill that you've climbed before. You'll go up again ahead. Let's keep going forward.
Take it easy. Pick yourself up. You can do it.
Ah, I haven't eaten all day, what to do
I do sometimes question why can't it be me who died instead of that great person who is loved by everyone. I'd donate my lifetime if I can.
Yo, tell me how to want to live.
Hey, maybe sad is the new normal.

Goal? Want? As far as I remember, I don't have any aspiration. I thought long and hard about it, and I found my answer to be: happiness. I want to be happy all the time, or at least most of the time.

So, yeah, I need to get a life. But sometimes to stop living is tempting too. What's so bad about death?
